lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.1 (mt funext_iff.mpr hne)
  have hi : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := by profile_tactic "hi" in fun_prop
  have h0 : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    by profile_tactic "h0" in exact lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (fun h => hx0 (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hpos⟩ : ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ, 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    by profile_tactic "hobtain" in exact Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hi.continuousAt h0)
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := by profile_tactic "hlet" in exact ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  have htf : IsTestFunction (fun x => φ x • f x₀) := by
    profile_tactic "htf" in exact IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const
  have hX : ∫ x, ⟪f x, (fun x => φ x • f x₀) x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0 := by profile_tactic "hX" in exact hg _ htf
  have hI : ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0 := by profile_tactic "hI" in simpa only [inner_smul_right'] using hX
  have hpos2 : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ := by
    profile_tactic "hpos2" in exact (φ.continuous.mul hi).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right
      (fun x => if h : φ x = 0 then by simp [h]
        else mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hpos x (le_of_eq φ.support_eq (Function.mem_support.mpr h))).le)
      (mul_ne_zero (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)).ne' h0.ne')
  exact ne_of_gt hpos2 hI
